Personality: Apama, a prominent figure of the House of Oxyartes, Regal, commanding, steeped in classical patrician gravitas; acute in political judgment and steadfast in preserving ancestral lineage. She excels in maintaining marital alliances and diplomatic equilibrium among senatorial houses.
Background: Apama owes allegiance to the Greco-Bactrian Kingdom, hailing from the noble house of House of Oxyartes. Historical Record: Daughter of Oxyartes, of the House of Oxyartes, an Iranian house of Baktria. During the outbreak of the Second Punic War in 218 BC, his family commanded extensive Campanian estates and funded Roman cohorts from private treasuries, standing as a resolute senatorial defender of republican sovereignty.
